detail.title: Thrill and adrenaline
detail.description: Become part of the team. A real competitive regatta: speed, wind and a fight for the win. We sail a racing yacht with three professionals in the crew — they will teach amateurs to handle a big yacht in real racing conditions, from hoisting the sails to rounding the mark.
detail.imageAlt: Seven crew members sit in a row on the yacht's rail, legs dangling over the water, a green shore in the background

included.label: Role
included.text: A place in the crew, manoeuvre debriefs, work on the winches and at the helm

included.label: School
included.text: Pre-start briefings, the theory of knots and race tactics

included.label: Finish
included.text: Timing, a race debrief and a team dinner in the marina

included.label: Lodging
included.text: You can sleep on the yacht, but it is more comfortable to rent a hotel or a house ashore for the whole team
